title: CharacterSkills component + tests (A/B eval)
instructions:
Create a NEW presentational React component `CharacterSkills` for the RE Deck Builder client, plus its test file. The component shows a character's level abilities (locked/unlocked) and progress toward the next level gate. It receives data ONLY via props (no store, no network, no CSS imports). ## FILES TO EMIT (exactly these two paths) 1. `client/src/ui/CharacterSkills.tsx` 2. `client/src/ui/CharacterSkills.test.tsx` ## Component contract — CharacterSkills.tsx Imports (use exactly these): ```tsx import type { JSX } from 'react'; import type { GameState, PlayerState } from '@re/game-core'; import { defForInstance } from './cards'; ``` Exported interface and function: ```tsx export interface CharacterSkillsProps { readonly state: GameState; readonly seat: number; } export function CharacterSkills({ state, seat }: CharacterSkillsProps): JSX.Element ``` Render rules (follow exactly): 1. `const player: PlayerState | undefined = state.seats[seat];` — when undefined, return `
—
` (the character between the tags is an em dash U+2014). 2. `const charDef = defForInstance(state, player.characterInstanceId);` — when null, return the same placeholder div as rule 1. 3. Otherwise return: ```tsx
{rows}
★ {player.decorations} {footerText}
``` 4. Build `const rows: JSX.Element[] = [];` then loop over `charDef.levels ?? []` in array order. For each entry: - `const unlocked = player.level >= entry.level;` - `const gate = entry.level === 1 ? charDef.level1At : charDef.level2At;` - `const gateText = gate === undefined ? '' : ' · ' + gate + '★';` (space, middle dot U+00B7, space, the gate number, star U+2605) - push this row: ```tsx
{'Lv' + entry.level + gateText} {entry.text}
``` 5. footerText, computed before the return: ```tsx const nextGate = player.level === 0 ? charDef.level1At : charDef.level2At; const footerText = player.level >= 2 || nextGate === undefined ? 'MAX LEVEL' : 'Next: ' + nextGate + '★'; ``` 6. Constraints: no classes anywhere, no default exports, no mutation of props/state. `CardDef` fields `level1At` and `level2At` are `number | undefined` — always narrow before use. `charDef.levels` is `readonly { level: 1 | 2; text: string }[] | undefined`. ## Test file — CharacterSkills.test.tsx Vitest runs in node env with NO jsdom: use `renderToStaticMarkup` from 'react-dom/server'. Imports: ```tsx import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'; import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'; import type { GameState, PlayerState } from '@re/game-core'; import { setup, startTurn, PREMIER_CARDS, FIRST_TIMER_PILES } from '@re/game-core'; import { CharacterSkills } from './CharacterSkills'; ``` Fixture builder (copy verbatim): ```tsx function stateFor(characterCardId: string, seat0: Partial = {}, seed = 11): GameState { const s = startTurn( setup( { seed, players: [{ name: 'Me', controller: 'human', characterCardId }, { name: 'Bot', controller: 'human' }] }, PREMIER_CARDS, FIRST_TIMER_PILES ) ); return { ...s, seats: s.seats.map((p, i) => (i === 0 ? { ...p, ...seat0 } : p)) }; } ``` Real card-database values (do not alter; these come from the engine data): - `ch-009` Jill Valentine: level1At 5, level2At 8; levels [{ level: 1, text: 'All your Explosive weapons get +5 damage.' }, { level: 2, text: 'Your Explosive weapons go to discard instead of being trashed.' }] - `pr-002` Jill Valentine (Promo): level1At 8, level2At undefined; levels [{ level: 1, text: 'At the beginning of your Turn, you can Skip your current Turn and Discard your Hand. At the beginning of your next Turn, you get +5 Cards, +1 Buy, +1 Action, and +1 Explore.' }] Wrap all tests in `describe('CharacterSkills', () => { ... });`.
